conventions.convention: Work in real Euclidean space of dimension n≥1 with exact real evaluations and arithmetic. The algorithm has finite outer budget K and separate bounded-strong-Wolfe and exact-SPD-quadratic modes.
Strong Wolfe uses 0<c1<c2<1/2, Armijo decrease, and |g_newᵀd|≤c2|g_oldᵀd|. The descent-angle cosine is −gᵀd/(‖g‖₂‖d‖₂).
PR+ truncates its coefficient at zero. A candidate is retained only when gᵀd≤−σ‖g‖₂² and ‖d‖₂≤C‖g‖₂, with fixed σ,C>0; otherwise the selected direction is −g.

Convergence concerns infinite recurrence sequences with nonzero gradients and successful strong Wolfe updates at every index, rather than infinite executions of the finite-budget algorithm. FR concludes only vanishing gradient liminf.
The line-search trial bound excludes initial-point data; the outer gradient count separately counts the initial gradient and one gradient after each accepted update.
The Rosenbrock example traces the actual dyadic bracketing/zoom output t=1/1024. The additional t=1/1000 calculation is explicitly a hypothetical valid Wolfe step, not that search's output.

load_bearing.statement: Defines finite-budget FR and safeguarded PR+ with zero-gradient exit, candidate formation, PR+ descent-and-norm restart tests, bounded strong Wolfe search or exact-SPD-quadratic line minimization, failure propagation, and stationary/search-failure/iteration-limit outputs.

For nonzero gradients following the stated FR recurrence and strong Wolfe curvature with 0<c2<1/2, define q_k=−g_kᵀd_k/‖g_k‖₂², δ=(1−2c2)/(1−c2), C3=(1+c2)/(1−c2), and S_k=Σ_{j=0}^k‖g_j‖₂⁻². Then δ≤q_k≤1/(1−c2) and ‖d_k‖₂²≤C3‖g_k‖₂⁴S_k for every k.
For g≠0, the stated PR+ safeguard with σ,C>0 produces a strictly descending direction whose descent-angle cosine is at least min{1,σ/C}>0.

On a real SPD quadratic in exact arithmetic, the FR recurrence with exact line minimization has the same iterates, residuals and directions as linear CG until the common zero-residual exit. Unrestarted raw PR+ has the same sequence; safeguarded PR+ has this equivalence only on runs where its safeguard does not restart.

For the stated infinite FR recurrence with nonzero gradients, feasible strong Wolfe updates, an objective bounded below on its initial sublevel set, and one Lipschitz-gradient constant on an open neighborhood containing every trial segment, liminf ‖g_k‖₂=0.
Under the referenced lower-bound and smoothness hypotheses, an infinite successful PR+ recurrence with the stated fixed safeguard, nonzero gradients and strong Wolfe steps satisfies ‖∇f(x_k)‖₂→0.

concerns.concern: Definition step 2 says “For k=0, use d_0 above,” whereas step 3 tests or assigns d_k^{cand}, which has only been explicitly formed for k≥1. The intended initialization d_0^{cand}=d_0=−g_0 is immediately recoverable, but should be explicit for the procedure's first iteration. A first-iteration restart also assigns β_{−1}, although no such coefficient is otherwise needed.
